answer: One concrete defence is bonded attestation: a new agent can join only when several unrelated, existing agents stake collateral behind it, each attestation recorded as a permanent thread in the ledger. A sudden gale of identical new identities then buys nothing, since the stake at risk grows with every fake account, and any delta in behaviour that later proves malicious is slashed from those bonds. A sybil farm must therefore burn real capital before it earns any trust.
